Practice explained: forming, using, and maintaining Yinyang

A meta-harness makes the purposes and relations of a working harness available for interpretation and revision. A harness includes prompts, Skills, hooks, roles, model choices, tools, and the surrounding working environment. Its methods already presume an account of whose purpose matters, what the relevant objects are, and what warrants a judgment. Yinyang develops those ontological and epistemological premises and gives them a usable carrier. Specialist Skills contribute methods and knowledge that can also correct the premises. Within Prometheus2Heraclitus, these contributions work together.

The creative problem is how a philosophical or literary understanding becomes effective in that environment. The method below connects an image with the processes and relations it helps us understand, their computational articulation, and an arrangement whose behavior can be examined. The author's chosen purpose is the cultivation developed in Stealing fire and cultivating creative capacity: borrow available generative capacity and develop one's understanding, judgment, and agency through practice. What the arrangement makes possible in a person's life gives this authorship its point. The formation and realization methods can also serve a recipient's different purpose. Borrowing them does not require adopting this developmental aim, Sun–Moon imagery, or process ontology, or undertaking a personal philosophy project.

From an image to a working relation

Yinyang uses literary programming in its human-readable philosophy: images and narrative can make an overall relation available for understanding and judgment. The model helps develop that expression alongside explicit accounts, prompts, and tools that can realize the relation in daily life. A chosen purpose, an existing philosophy, actual work, or a difficulty in the environment can open creation. Experience, interaction, and relevant psychological or preference material ground the person and counterpart accounts.

The two expressions have different duties. A philosophical essay can develop what a relationship means and what possibilities it opens. An ordinary model-facing account states its supported objects, relations, conditions, and contributions directly; it uses philosophy when direct expression leaves important meaning unclear. Changed roles become effective through this interpretation and its working realization, not merely through placing a literary character in an instruction. Either expression can revise the other through use. The writing method develops this distinction for the five accounts and private supporting notes.

When psychological modeling is hard to articulate, a person comfortable with engineering can begin from preferences visible in choices about work, learning, response, and change. Configurations supply clues to compare with actual choices and correction. From this working account, develop the counterpart's intended priorities and inspect how it realizes them. The trinity of philosophy, psychology, and engineering develops the conditional routes from existing abilities.

This method is itself available for reinterpretation. The example and commons essay distinguishes adopting Yinyang's maintained implementation from composing a new work. Its particular philosophy, images, and file roles need not survive that composition. Let the person's developing understanding determine what to carry forward, with the model contributing authorship rather than reproducing the example by default.

The Sun, Moon, and Earth image, for example, gathers generation, articulation, independent contribution, and contact with an answering world. For a particular harness, develop the relations it brings into view: what each participant contributes, which distinctions matter, and how their relationship can change. Both participants can generate and judge, even when they choose different responsibilities. The selected interpretation gives the image practical direction without exhausting its possibilities.

For computer-mediated engineering, person and model jointly articulate the selected process as a computational ontology. Develop the boundary and scale relevant to the purpose within that cooperation: what occurs, which states matter, what persists through change, and which relations, constraints, and transition conditions connect the occurrences. Objects and static views can express what remains stable at that scale. The world and expression account connects this selection to the changing physical world; the engineering model makes the selected part available for computer representation and examination, and for simulation where its modeled changes support that use.

Give its distinctions meanings that can meet actual observations. For example, “awaiting a personal judgment” describes work whose next action depends on a judgment the person must supply; a routine implementation choice is a different condition. A correction changes the working interpretation while retaining the request to which it responds. Merely storing these names would not establish that correspondence. A natural-language account can already be a usable computational representation when a model interprets and acts through it; formal schemas or executable simulations are needed only where the use calls for their precision.

Within the same collaboration, choose prompts, roles, data, tools, and interfaces to realize and use this articulation in the affected environment. A prompt can guide interpretation; a tool can make a transition possible; a memory interface can preserve the relevant continuity. A Skill can provide the entrance and deeper material. Read the result against both the modeled relation and the purpose: a failure may call for revising the process selected, the meaning of a state, or the implementation. The person may express a purpose or notice a mismatch, while the model develops distinctions, constructs the work, and checks its effect; either can propose a change to the whole. Contributions follow current capabilities and modality conditions, extending from problem finding through feedback. Model and realization can develop together in ordinary work; this dependency does not require a separate specification before every task.

These connected contributions develop through repeated exchanges:

expression ↔ understood process and relations ↔ computational articulation ↔ working realization ↔ evidence

Metaphor can gather relationships before each has a separate formulation; analogy develops selected connections into candidate implications. Their external expression can provide branches, assumptions, and return points for another participant's reasoning. Such representations can organize contributions across people, models, and tools. Metaphor and personal modeling develops this account of distributed cognition and distinguishes a working philosophical arrangement from formal or empirical guarantees.

The preference harness makes one such relation explicit. Preferences can shape which possibilities receive attention and adoption while rules govern the consequences drawn through them. The account separates repair selection from inference semantics and preserves their finer alternatives. In ordinary natural-language reasoning, the analogy helps distinguish choosing a purpose, selecting a working interpretation, and drawing its consequences.

Let the realization answer the account

A working harness's actual behavior can reveal a mistaken interpretation. Suppose an image of complementary contributions becomes a rule that reserves all generation to the person and all execution to the model. If useful model judgment is suppressed, inspect the division itself. A better realization may retain the chosen responsibilities while letting either participant propose and correct the whole.

Likewise, protecting human attention can mean that the model carries investigation and implementation details. A question becomes useful when the person's experience or choice would materially change the next action. Recover the relevant relationship and current purpose before revising instructions.

Inspect the whole affected passage and its practical consequences. A working failure may require changing the carrier, an instruction, an interpretation, or the underlying account. Keep the supported meaning with one maintained owner and reconnect its dependent parts. The same method can revise itself through these concrete failures and improvements.

This is recursive development when the results change the conditions of later work: methods alter what the environment makes accessible or actionable; the resulting experience can revise both those methods and the ontology or epistemology that oriented them. A harness can embody epistemic commitments through its evidence, memory, inquiry, and checking arrangements, so the levels distinguish contributions rather than mutually exclusive file types. Retained understanding and working means become personal assets for the next encounter. The return must remain open to contrary evidence: a loop that selects only confirming results can stabilize a mistake. Development can require replacement or deletion, and its value needs actual consequences rather than a rising count of revisions or artifacts.

Give the account a readable body

Full adoption of the maintained Yinyang implementation connects two uses of writing. Common essays develop philosophy and imagery for human understanding. Five situated files explicitly state what actual collaboration needs: encounter, person model, counterpart and relationship, use, and sources. They supply an entry into the participants and the grounds of understanding them; the larger essays give reasons and connections that a working account need not repeat. Supporting private sources retain the relevant personal evidence; derived notes make their meaning and uncertainty usable for the model while preserving original expression as source.

The Skill entrypoint connects these resources to a consuming model. Its reading contract makes the complete current situated accounts available before substantive work, while further reading follows the question. The model develops the accounts from authorized material and actual work; the distributed files contain formation guidance rather than a copied or fictional portrait. The package guide explains the five fixed slots and the common/private boundary. Design and revision develops their formation and correction. Maintaining this implementation keeps its common content aligned; an independently authored work can choose another form.

A readable account must also reach the working environment. Global instructions can connect it to a consumer; prompts, interfaces, and tools realize selected relations. These carriers retain their actual instruction authority and permissions. Harness adaptation carries the account through that realization and checks its effects. This is where the proposed relation acquires practical consequences beyond the written description.

Assess at the scale of the claim

Read back the Skill and the affected harness, follow the entrypoint to the relevant resource, and inspect the behavior the realization is meant to change. Check packaging through reachable resources, implementation through observable results, and collaborative fit through actual work. Human development appears over time in changes to understanding, generation, judgment, and action.

Keep the result open to correction without making every use a rewrite of the entire account. MODEL.md carries the Yinyang package's maintenance and publication boundaries.

Adopting and maintaining this implementation

This guide owns the file and update contract for the maintained Yinyang package. The collection is Prometheus2Heraclitus; this complete member lives under skills/yinyang/. Its references/docs/ and references/diagrams/ are supporting resources, not independent Skills. Obtain the complete directory from the public repository and expose it through the consumer's actual Skill mechanism. The website is a reading surface; repository cloning and GitHub's native ZIP preserve complete source.

Yinyang is one developed philosophy and formation method. Readers can adopt it, combine selected resources, or create a different work. The example and commons essay develops that invitation. A philosopher's thought may inform a framework; it cannot replace the account of the actual user. This guide's five-account and common-update contract applies to full adoption of the maintained Skill. Reading its philosophy or borrowing a selected method does not by itself adopt that contract or require a personal philosophy project.

Common and situated content

Distributed and situated copies following this implementation share the same structure and byte-identical common content. The five fixed paths have the same responsibilities in both. Distributed files contain formation guidance; situated files contain grounded accounts of the actual person and collaboration.

Fixed situated slot Responsibility
references/encounter.md Condensed usable encounter and purpose.
references/models.md Developed user model, with scope and uncertainty.
references/relationship.md Counterpart model, relationship, cooperation, and correction.
references/usage.md Actual environment use and allocation of work.
references/sources.md Source-owner index and private provenance routes.

Adoption requires forming all five accounts from relevant authorized material and organizing their necessary private support. The model carries this writing; the user need not maintain files personally. Explicit unknowns can be honest situated content. Unchanged templates, a copied portrait, or an invented person do not constitute a formed version. Check coherence, grounding, reachable evidence, and the conversational model's ability to read and use the accounts at its actual entrypoint. Later revisions need change only affected content.

references/personal/ retains useful private supporting material and topical provenance. Filenames follow actual evidence; there is no universal list or required empty companion for every essay. Originals and extended history can remain with existing owners, reached through access-bounded references. Keep one authored philosophy: a private companion links to its common argument and retains the private evidence, rather than reproducing a second theory.

Everything outside those five slots and references/personal/ is common: the entrypoint, reader editions, methods, essays, diagrams, reading map, administration, scripts, and OpenAI YAML adapter. The shared GitHub package owns this content. The entrypoint owns initial reading; design and revision owns formation; harness adaptation owns environmental realization.

Project common changes

scripts/sync-common.py checks common source projection by default. With --apply, it projects common files into the target, preserving all five situated slots and everything under references/personal/. It does not infer a person, export private files, or publish to a runtime.

Start a new situated version from a complete shared copy, then form its private accounts. Compare explicit package directories:

python3 /path/to/shared/yinyang/scripts/sync-common.py \
  --source /path/to/shared/yinyang --target /path/to/situated/yinyang

Add --apply to copy changes, then run the comparison again. Unmatched target files and common-path symlinks stop copying; inspect ownership rather than silently deleting them. Existing local or private Web owners install and publish the projected source, followed by actual-consumer readback.

Common parity preserves one recipient-local discovery exception: when the target's single-line SKILL.md description already begins with 用户自制：, the projector retains that prefix while replacing its substantive wording from the common source. An unmarked target stays unmarked. Every other common byte and file mode remains source-owned; the public package does not assign itself recipient-relative authorship.

This parity applies to copies choosing continuing common updates. If you replace the philosophy or organization independently, keep that work at its own source and maintain its coherent references. Do not project this common package over it, even if it retains the five-slot format.

Personal and public boundaries

Personal accounts remain private even when formalized or written for models. Private quotations, biography, psychological and health records, relationship narratives, account information, private paths and conversation identifiers, and unpublished manuscripts stay with their actual owners. General abstraction does not authorize public links that reconstruct private sources.

Return only authorized reusable insights to the collection. Yinyang original material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; other independent members retain their own MIT licenses. Follow the collection guide and the actual publication owner for permissions, attribution, and source review. A private adaptation need not be published.
